story_theme_en: Mali watches a TV program starting at 19:30 and ending at 21:15. During the show, there are advertisements lasting 25 minutes in total. How long does Mali actually watch the program?
helper_tip: Convert times to total minutes first, then subtract to find the difference.

visual_blocks.title: Story
visual_blocks.content: Mali watches a TV program starting at 19:30 and ending at 21:15. During the show, there are advertisements lasting 25 minutes in total. How long does Mali actually watch the program? And if a new program starts immediately after at 21:15, what time does the new program start?

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Step 1: Find total watch time → 21:15 - 19:30 = 1 hour 45 minutes | Step 2: Subtract ads → 1h 45min - 25min = actual watching time
